title: Native mobile client (iOS/Android)
description: Build a native mobile client using the Rust engine cross-compiled to iOS (via cargo-lipo/swift bridge) and Android (via JNI/cargo-ndk). MIT-licensed engine makes this viable for app store distribution. Needs: native UI layer for board rendering, WebSocket transport, touch interaction model (tap-to-select, tap-to-place). Depends on WebSocket capability negotiation being specced.
close_reason: Superseded by baize-6abh (Flutter epic). Flutter targets iOS/Android/desktop from one codebase.
